title: Weather Stress, Disease, Contamination, and Wildlife Workbook
purpose: Support traceable decisions for wind, heat/drought, wet-weather disease risk, smoke/dust events, and vertebrate damage.

sections.title: Wind and Structural Support Record
sections.decisionPrompt: Did failure originate in wind exposure, plant architecture, anchorage, or support design?

sections.title: Heat and Drought Stress Record
sections.decisionPrompt: Which measurement best distinguishes atmospheric heat load from root-zone water limitation?

sections.title: Rain, Dew, and Flower-Disease Record
sections.decisionPrompt: Does wetness duration and flower architecture support a disease-risk hypothesis that requires sampling or hold action?

sections.title: Smoke and Dust Event Record
sections.decisionPrompt: What evidence is required before exposed crop can be released, held, or rejected?

sections.title: Wildlife Damage and Exclusion Record
sections.decisionPrompt: Does the evidence support the suspected species and the selected exclusion method?

qualityRules: Separate worker-safety decisions from crop-quality decisions.
Use measurements and samples rather than visual assumptions when contamination or disease is plausible.
Document weather-event timing and crop stage.
